FX.title: [USD/JPY] UP: Price Above MA20 with Modest RSI Bullishness Amid Mixed Risk Sentiment
tldr_points: Price above MA20 suggests short‑term bullish bias.
RSI ~58 indicates moderate upward momentum without overbought conditions.
Mixed risk sentiment and steady US yields support dollar strength vs yen.
FX.excerpt: USD/JPY trades above MA20 at 159.70, RSI near 58, supported by steady yields and risk‑off flows favoring the dollar.
FX.comment: Price above MA20 with bullish momentum and steady yield support

STOCKS.excerpt: S&P 500 faces technical breakdown below MA20 amid shifting fundamentals and waning momentum.
